verdict.rationale: Spline documents a no-code interactivity model built from 'states, events and actions' (spline-docs-31) and references screen-based design ('describe a screen and Hana designs it', spline-docs-21), supporting no-code UI wiring. However, the evidence never explicitly describes screen-to-screen prototyping concepts like triggers between distinct screens, transitions, or overlay behavior in the Figma-prototyping sense. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of screen linking/transitions, overlay-style layering between screens, and any hands-on/independent confirmation that clickable multi-screen prototypes (not just single-scene interactivity) work as described.
